university: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
program_name: Master of Science in Digital Transformation

fees.notes: APU official course page: total international tuition RM42,000 (excludes 6% SST). Source: https://www.apu.edu.my/course/msc-in-digital-transformation (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
requirements.general: Bachelor’s degree Bachelor’s degree in Computing or related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, or its equivalent qualification as accepted by the Senate. Bachelor’s degree in Computing or related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50 can be accepted, subject to a rigorous internal assessment. Bachelor’s degree in non-related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 as accepted by the Senate and with relevant working experience, subject to a rigorous internal assessment. Bachelor’s degree in non-related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 as accepted by the Senate and without relevant working experience, subject to passing pre-requisite courses. Note: The above entry requirements may differ for specific programmes based on the latest programme standards published by Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA).
